notes.title: Crypterion 1.0 Full Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/eac8eea2dd823e5507a91e7547e50c9b92120a74.jpg[/img]

If you’re new to Crypterion, check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048860/Crypterion/]store page[/url] for a full rundown of its unique features and charm. This announcement focuses on the latest patch notes, highlighting fresh content and improvements for both newcomers and long-time supporters.

[h1]Recent Enhancements:[/h1]
- The Face-to-Face T.V. Show episodes are no longer repeatable, making it more likely to see them all.

- A spy has been added. They’re hidden among the crew—can you uncover them?

- 16 new non-steam achievements, bringing the total to 39. These unlock the path to discovering the lost city of Iclantia.

- The advertisement room now reflects the removal of commodity advertising.

- A [b]VR computer[/b] is introduced in the Fun Zone. Because of its intricate Iclantian tech, it will take clever players to figure it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/83117f34e85dfc15401a657ef358677c1eb32337.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/cad37856465e626b13fcfed686b4bf1f174aaa8e.png[/img]
[i](the Iclantian tech - unpowered)[/i]

- The true ending and credits have been added, for a total of three credit scenes (Gallery, first ending, and second ending).

- Kickstarter backers now properly appear in the true ending credits.

- Use the universal translator to understand a language.

- A new flier shows up on the bounty board over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/cf649d49b98bc756d1a143f0e69a5458c1bc59ad.png[/img]

- The cat adoption agency is now reachable.

- The Comet Hotline agency is now accessible.

- Two new backgrounds enrich a fresh location.

- The Time room updates upon endgame to hint at hidden secrets.

- A new [b]photo collection[/b] system appears in the treasury.

- Renamed the second story-arc (Empress and Faction) to the “Iclantian Arc,” with an option to choose a companion for the journey.

- Asteroid effects updated in the main menu and on planet Umbra.

Great effort went into the art to bring you original characters and hand-painted backgrounds, some of which may appear only once during unique encounters:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/0025e531082463bbe9091a04eb89cb48c13c7c39.png[/img]
[i]Juniper helping you overcome a catastrophe[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/dad40d0c8c528244e4a04e75ac21add0a0668c5e.png[/img]
[i]Millie... also helping you overcome a catastrophe[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/ef06e914b0a880d635a0c67ea257a553c93dc781.png[/img]
[i]Astra celebrating me finally making it to 1.0![/i]

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
- Cleared up huge bug that would stop progression if you went ''remain as friends'' rout.
- Opportunity events are no longer missed when the time clock isn’t fixed.
- Prevented being able to start Ice-cream event when Moxie is not present.
- Fixed various typos and made corrections (thanks, Arcanestomper).
- Adjusted some dialogues for smoother flow.
- Prevented overlapping fonts in the Time room.
- Improved shield collision in the flight mini-game.
- Polished certain dialogue to maintain continuity on how to become emperor.
- Vivi no longer appears on the wrong planet background. Missing her on the first visit no longer blocks future appearances.
- Nanami’s gladiator event now only triggers with the proper crew.

[b]Note: Some Early Access requests are still in progress. I aim to add them as quality-of-life updates.[/b]

As I've worked hard to reach this point, hopefully I've earned your review, then go check out the previous update which added new opportunities for the player to discover.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1048860/view/542217277081125677

[h1]Final Thoughts[/h1]
I felt like I could keep going and adding content forever, but I had to bring it to 1.0 eventually. The 1.0 update focuses mostly on bringing everything together in the time room, which will lead you to the games greatest secret. Previous (post-opportunity update) saved games should work. Although, I've only been able to test my own saved games. Yea, best to start over just in case.

My next update needs a larger player-base since it focuses on the community. Let's see how launch goes and take it from there!

[h1]Digital Artbook[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/1ab9513335ba073c3935b9e58e3ae748033a5416.png[/img]

A [b]digital art book[/b] releases alongside the game. It includes work from the many artists who contributed to the backgrounds and characters. This fulfills the promise I made to my Kickstarter backers and will be delivered to them as you read this :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/d805be87363c1413fe733dc6e3c1872e22de4976.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/b31d817a726b0ad997817c6f6c28793e8e5bf161.png[/img]

notes.title: Opportunities Update Live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/53468ae07c0a4e282dc56653ef954ce5432dd67e.png[/img]

[h2]Details:[/h2]

This update introduces story moments and lucrative business opportunities that focus on you rather than your crew. These can be discovered while exploring planet surfaces or through specific phone calls from your small business.

The time clock has been overhauled to provide hints (once repaired) about their locations, but they can still be missed or end dramatically if you arrive unprepared.[i] *Content appears early, around the time you reach the station.[/i]

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[b]Features:[/b]

[*] Time clock enhancements to provide clues to help you discover business opportunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/ec6bbdbe94e4ead45eaf81a4dd4290d5642f754a.png[/img]
[*] Increased planet goods output to accommodate the future new advertisement system.
[*] Increased default font size to enhance visibility and prepare for mobile gaming platforms.
[*] Added a new system to allow players to buy planetary cryptos during events.
[*] Increased the planetary cryptos purchase limit to 300 per visit.
[*] Made more background objects interactive.
[*] Added a secret event for players to discover.
[*] Added a second secret event for players to discover.
[*] Added secret phone numbers to call.
[*] Made more store-bought items usable.
[*] Increased power gain from discovering a specific hidden artifact.
[*] Added 10 new characters to the cast, appearing throughout your adventure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/4923e35269e79f733f6166cc12d38dc6ba1cf241.png[/img]

[b]Lilian[/b] - An ancient Numari who holds the secrets of the past.
[b]Sylvar[/b] - A disgruntled fleet commander with extensive experience and a troubled history.
[b]Vivi[/b] - A mysterious fairy wisp with the power to grant your every wish.
[b]Chase[/b] - An information specialist and savvy opportunist.
[b]Sable[/b] - A bounty hunter and gadgeteer, skilled in collecting and using advanced technology.
[b]Theo[/b] - A shrewd and calculated entrepreneur whose ethics and intentions remain a mystery. 
[b]Cedrix[/b] - A wealthy stockbroker and business investor, known for his strategic acumen.
[b]Ranke[/b] - A highly decorated elite fighter with an unmatched love for battle.
[b]Cassandra[/b] -  Co-director at Vortex Nexus and a key investor in breakthrough technologies.
[b]Taro[/b] - A playful spirit juggling part-time jobs, with a passion for drama and a flair for the stage.

[u]Approximately 17 single-spaced pages of new dialogue (8,355 words)[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/5329f424f96a4509b31eabe53b00364bdfbeeca7.jpg[/img]
[*] Added 57 choices that impact your adventure in both small and significant ways.
[*] Added two fun interactive quizzes featuring a variety of questions and a reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/3b51b53292c7e723d86c0fdf25922b07b3ecea47.png[/img]

[*] New default phone call scenarios
[*] Now able to earn a broader range of rewards through events, such as ship enhancements and increased popularity
[*] Added visual clues to help find Astra when missing
[*] Added two new outfits for a character unlocked through player choices leading to a special event.

[h2]Random Events Explained:[/h2]
I realized during testing that galaxy map side-story events can indeed be missed, either because they don’t appear often enough or they are easy to overlook. For now, I am keeping the system as it is. With time and a sharp eye, players can eventually find all the events. This approach reduces repetitive story moments. The goal was to give each player a unique experience in some way.

At first, the chance of encountering these events is high, but the probability decreases as more are experienced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/0587c9d3de0ae13dff5510f1188b7f9a5e64edb9.jpg[/img]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Time clock getting stuck at year 1, day 1 under certain circumstances.
[*] Time clock not displaying pointer at last week of year
[*] Removed 'the end' terminology from first set of credits in preparation for 1.0 update
[/list]
As I continue to update and improve the game, [b]hopefully I've earned your wishlist[/b], then go check out the previous update which enhanced the tutorial and announced my publisher:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1048860/view/4661879143249339347]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1048860/view/4661879143249339347[/url]

[h3]> The game is on sale from December 19th until January 2nd![/h3]

[h3]Demo Troubleshooting:[/h3]
For those playing the full game from the demo. Navigate to the save location of the demo. It would be: c:/users/[your user name]/AppData/Local/Crypterion_Demo (also shown in the image)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/3931839da11de61a86b1933aba1e8b0283d0d9da.jpg[/img]

Copy the save game file there, and place it inside the Crypterion folder. Basically, the same "local" location. If you don't see that folder, starting a game in the full version and traveling to your first planet should create it with it's own saved game.

notes.title: Crypterion Space Exploration & Auction Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/a86c7aa46aaf04cc38f7c8adcf4e987ccfb55d67.png[/img]

[h2]Art Enhancements:[/h2]

[b]Let's enjoy the "Steam Space Exploration Fest"[/b] by adding and enhancing the galaxy with several places to explore! Many backgrounds and placeholder's have been removed and replaced with artist hand drawn art. I will be posting some images which could be [b][u]spoilers[/u][/b] for those that what to discover all Crypterion has to offer on their own.

[u]The new art includes[/u]:
[b]- 8 Auction signs[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/8d55670feac4b8c0a0cb235e4876d98aff4f7527.png[/img]

When an auction is open, it will display the item which is being auctioned.

- 2 artifacts, 1 with 4 variations
- 8 Background destinations, 1 with variation
- 2 polished and fixed CGI

[b]SPOILER LOCATIONS:[/b]
There are several destinations you will encounter. Build relationships with your crew members and make the hard choices. These are four examples:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/df025f3e7b288cff3df2aef6280803035db1d4fc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/16d1461ecddf3a6cd66b1a74e5afaf89d93a5993.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/3b9f92ea7339a35766b382cd05875042174ac4fc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/027327278daa9ea7d3471355cc5c4491fa9dcb7b.png[/img]

- 2 new treasury icons
- 3 food dishes for cook event
- 1 figurine with two variations
- 2 fighters for Nanami event
- Juniper medical license v.4

[h2]The Auction House:[/h2]
The auction house opens periodically as you progress the story. Once the main story is finished, it remains open so long as there are items to buy, and you can go as often as you wish.

[u]These are key things to remember when attending an auction[/u]:

[b]1) You cannot bid more money than you have[/b] [i](going into debt has been removed)[/i]. This makes it important not to attend auctions too frequently until you are prepared to win.

[b]2) You can lose an item for good[/b]. This makes winning much more rewarding. If you lose, it will become more difficult to obtain the item later, and some items cannot be acquired again.

[b]3) Bidding happens in three stages[/b]. You use each stage to determine how much money others are willing to spend. Depending on how much you bid in the first two stages, others may bid more or less. If you can gauge this correctly, you will save much more money during bidding.

[b]4) Easy mode.[/b] This iteration of the Auction House is on the easier side for testing purposes. I will balance difficulty for 1.0 release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/ccaffe51c2ed10ef86a63503d6f86c89b536ccca.jpg[/img]
[i](I'm rich! Totally legitimately earned. Nothing suspicious here.)[/i]

[h2]Planet Facilities:[/h2]
[b]A total of 4 facilities[/b] can now be acquired and appear on planets whether you own them or not. For this update, they can bring in extra income. But shortly in the future, you'll be able to interact with them.

The time room, along with this clock, will provide a significant source or experiences as well as a little... time bending. Now that the auction functionality is complete, you can look forward to these enhancements in the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/a09541c950f084d47189c6c18f1459a654854f38.jpg[/img]

[h2]What it's about:[/h2]

Besides typing up patch notes, I want to emphasize that Crypterion is dialogue and choices heavy and is becoming even more so with this update. In most cases, you will not know it's happening, unless you were to play the game over with different choices.

I have about 400-500 pages of dialogue lumped into this small universe. Much of the reading is unique to your playthrough aside from the main story quest.

notes.title: Faction Arc details and future plans
notes.content:
I'm getting closer to the 1.0 release, and there's just one more update planned before that. Let me share what I hope to achieve.

[h2]Dialogue Choices & Story:[/h2]
Crypterion has been a unique challenge due to its open-world approach as a visual novel. It's quite rare to describe a visual novel as open-world, but that's what Crypterion feels like. While it follows a linear storyline, players have the freedom to explore and run their business. There are also significant story moments that offer pages of completely different dialogue based off choices.

I came across a statistic mentioning that the average visual novel consists of around 90,000 words. The last update of Crypterion reached approximately 124,000 words. I estimate that at least 24,000 of those words will remain unread unless players make different choices during another playthrough. For example, the [b]first vacation event[/b] features six distinct branching story moments, and the [b]business rep. events[/b] have six different branching storylines.

Once the main story is finished, players can delve into two additional arcs: the [u]Empress Arc[/u] and the [u]Faction Arc[/u]. These add an extra 1-2 hours of gameplay. Various significant events contribute another 1-2 hours each, creating a rich and expansive experience. While I aimed to provide players with freedom and choices, it did pose a challenge for those who prefer a steady pace and straightforward content consumption.

The Empress Arc Update addressed story pacing for the initial 6-10 hours of gameplay [i](time depends on how fast you read and if you get into the Tycoon aspect)[/i], but beyond that point, players will need to engage in some exploration with the help of their crew (the Informant) to uncover new content. The achievements also serve as a guiding tool.

[h3]Final story moments and events:[/h3]
My goal is to complete both arcs and introduce events related to the objects players have purchased with their hard-earned money.
(* = finished / # = in progress)

- #[b]Faction Arc[/b] - If pursuing Astra's ending, you are locked into the Faction Arc. A new challenge awaits as you face off against the Factions. They are seeking power, and a life is in danger.
- *Vacation with the Numari's (a plant like species) who are universally loved by players :)
- *2 New minigame activities
- *Digital Camera available in the shop
- *Interactive Ending credits
- #Umbrella event
- #Computer access terminal
- #Fun Zone Store
- #Discover Iclantia

Additionally, I am aware that the crew of ten characters requires more screen time, and I am actively working on addressing this.

[b]In progress:[/b]
- Fan art book
- Steam cards and achievements
- Auction house changes

The achievements will be released with the 1.0 version.

[b]Patch Release Date:[/b]
Ideally, I would like to release the patch in June or early July, but setting precise dates is challenging.

[b]My concerns and 1.0 release thoughts:[/b]
Crypterion has been in early access for several years, and during this time, it has reached only a limited number of players. Unfortunately, I have been too focused on developing the game to allocate enough time for promotion. Since the last build, the game has reached a state that I am satisfied with. However, I recognize the need to invest a significant amount of time in distributing keys to garner press coverage before the 1.0 release. This process may cause a delay. I'm open for suggestions.

The positive reviews have been incredibly encouraging, and I have made game improvements based on the feedback provided by critics. My intention from the beginning was to create Crypterion as a game and story that immerses players completely. With the upcoming 1.0 release, my hope is to deliver that full and captivating experience.

This is a sneak peak at what's coming in [b]Crypterion's next build[/b].

[h2][b]Galaxy Events[/b][/h2]
The biggest focus is events that take place in the Remnos System. I'm not going to put a picture here because it's better seeing the changes as you play.

The map was only about travel to other planets, but now it's also about catching visual events that you can find and identify on the map. Things to know about them:

- They are all optional
- The newspaper will describe these mysterious events
- Most of them require someone with a specific skill-set
- You will earn big rewards from them
- More opportunities to interact with all crew members

[h2][b]Newspaper and Planetary Storms[/b][/h2]
Now that we have events happening in the galaxy, it is useful to read the newspaper. This also includes storms that take place. A [i][b]planet with storms[/b][/i] will not have a great harvest and goods will be expensive should you visit there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/31100e4d1c891294da8c2dc77a1a35f3c228c0c9.png[/img]

[b]The space station[/b] has some changes you will notice the moment you arrive. Some buttons to inform you of taxes and wages owed. Some action is also taking place outside of the station.

notes.title: Character Relationships, Business Updates, Polish.
notes.content:
I've been working diligently on [b]Crypterion's next build[/b] and have made good progress. It's safe to say the next update is a big one. Starting with [b]fan art[/b], there are several artists working on fantastic pieces for the gallery.

The gallery is a place to collect art submitted to the game. Story scenes also appear in your personal gallery. Anyone may submit art by contacting me on the discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/c324c27866b53670dc59976c782192c83191cbf0.png[/img]

[h2][b]Building relationships[/b][/h2]
The next update will have new dialogue for all characters. You'll be able to [b]go on dates[/b] now that relationships have reached a deeper level or you can avoid that completely. Either way, you become good friends with your crew. [b]Vote for your favorites[/b] on the Discord Channel https://discord.gg/9TkdqUJ.

[h2][b]Story editing pass #1[/b][/h2]
Half the dialogue in game has been fully edited (not be me, but with professional help). The other half of editing is waiting on some more writing and fixes to encounters. You should be able to notice the difference now though.

[h2][b]Small Business Statistics[/b][/h2]
This --->
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/b915bd2bcd22a96dd22fc30a9145e37971e19c19.png[/img]

Becomes this --->
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/5f01a854dc72259f93b9f61d659080c41f54e838.png[/img]

And now there is more to do! Focusing on three examples: The [b]phone is fully activated[/b] since last build and you can prank call anyone you like. Or perhaps find a real-hidden-secret number and see who you get.

- The [b]bounty board[/b] is getting more additions. Already, you can [b]track down a bounty[/b].

- Click the [b]computer monitor[/b] and get business statistics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/408dd0d42d71297d86db18b1757058aca2b52973.png[/img]

Track how much money you're making and total customers. Once fully unlocked, you [b]can choose from 6 different representatives[/b]. They will be part of your advertisement efforts including: News, Photography, and Film. > Experience 4 special events with the representative you choose.

[h2][b]Achievements[/b][/h2]
These are shown in your collection room and will be a part of Steam's unlockable achievements when ready. They have a unique design once flipped. They tell a few secrets now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/6e06129a21fe04f15332a79a21ba494148dfed32.png[/img]

[h2][b]Crew Interactions[/b][/h2]
Looks like Juniper set up shop and even got her first appointment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/8dee468ab9539162446e87c2ae49441e6e375fe6.png[/img]

That brings us to [b]dialogue[/b]. There is a cast of 28 characters and 11 of those are part of your crew or company employee's. Interact with them as you grow your business. Some of them set up shop on your ship, such as Juniper who is the ship doctor. Others, like Erand, become the games hint system. Each crew member enhances gameplay.

[h2][b]The Mysterious Arcade[/b][/h2]
Somewhat of a spoiler, but not for those that want news and more to be excited about. This is an arcade that will appear and activate only when secret conditions are met. This also represents an achievement. Those who find the arcade will be able to play the MMO "Endless".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/61a3da60ac3d7cccd8da01103c095b51b34e2a6f.png[/img]

Newly introduced in the last patch was Sunny Dae's newspaper. It's meant to give you a heads up on galaxy events and track your popularity.

I've received comments that the media room is a lot of fun, but there is not enough to do there. Upgrading your celebrity status will be an end game goal that will introduce you to more events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/e8ccf7782f0a23210894f9445d33a8ef8baab367.png[/img]

Hmm, should I share more, or is that it for now? Maybe next time I'll tell you what comes of that [b]million dollar ice-cream cone[/b].

notes.content:
[h1]Crypterion Development[/h1]
Crypterion has been undergoing big updates and changes. Nearly every area of the game has been enhanced in the last 2 months.

[b]September 2019[/b]
- redesigned planet UI
- major loan room changes
- redesigned marketplace
- first CG scene added
- 4 new backgrounds added
- Finished interactive CG screen

[b]October[/b]
- planet UI redesigned (*again with further improvements)
- loan room graphic enhances
- marketplace graphic enhancements
- space station total redesign
- media room redesigned with improvements
- added animations to 3 planet backgrounds

[b]November[/b]
- Marketplace goods replaced
- Advertisement options replaced
- New trailer and screenshots uploaded on Steam

[b][i]* To celebrate, download and enjoy these chibi's from our temporary webpage.[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/6611d8768e16d23fd0dfd84a3a0b4c4427b324d1.png[/img]

[h1]Use of these chibis is as follows:[/h1][list]
[*] You may not sell or distribute these files.
[*] They can be used personally, but not commercially.
[*] You may post on social channels and show to anyone you like :)
[*] Edit the art to make badges, forum icons, or other things you'd like to use online
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/b0a9accb8a8ad22b12ac40c42bf20a2e9831c544.png[/img]

[b]With your crew, you will explore and trade on different worlds![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/3d1fcfb9022ac76ea21d5b03236bebb3941ec8f1.jpg[/img]

Soon, I will detail how you can be involved with the game even so far as being "in" the game. Many new areas are waiting to be revealed such as the space station, the throne room, auction house, collection room, gallery, and a wide variety of worlds.[b] [u]Wishlist and follow so you don't miss out. I hope that you will join us in the closed alpha.[/u][/b]

[b]Development Log:[/b] https://steamcommunity.com/app/1048860/discussions/
